name: Tames-the-Beast
location: Blackrose Prison; Hall of Beasts, Mess Hall of Misery

abilities.name: Taking Aim
abilities.description: Tames-the-Beast channels a powerful Snipe from his bow, hitting whomever has him taunted. This ability can be interrupted by bashing the boss to avoid the massive physical damage it inflicts.

abilities.name: Crushing Roots
abilities.description: Tames-the Beast will channel an ability that roots you in place and inflicts high continuous physical damage to you. You must roll-dodge to break free.

abilities.name: Swarm
abilities.description: Upon reaching 50% and 25% health, Tames-the-Beast will send a swarm of insects to bite a party member. The group must stack on the affected player and share the damage, similar to the Shade of Siroria's Roaring Flare ability from Cloudrest. If the damage is not split between the group, the swarm of insects will kill their target. This ability lasts for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Pet Summons
abilities.description: At certain health percentages, Tames-the-Beast will signal for a powerful monster to join him in battle. At 80% health, he will summon a River Troll, at 60%, he summons a Haj Mota, and at 40% health he summons a Wamasu. It is recommended that the group destroys these adds before putting more damage out onto Tames-the-Beast.

abilities.name: Enrage
abilities.description: If the group neglects to kill the Troll, Haj Mota and Wamasu he spawns during the fight, Tames-the-Beast and his remaining pets will enrage, increasing the damage they deal.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: Do the challengers expect to win like this?

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: A foul wind has blown for our challengers, it seems.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: Ka-ha-ha! These spineless weaklings will never win.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: Watch as these kuudas struggle. Pathetic.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: Looks like these limp-fins can't take much more.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: Is that all these kuudas can muster?

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: A mire gnat bites harder than these challengers.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: Was that a hit? I could barely tell.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: Our prey finally puts up a fight.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: This is what you bring us, Drakeeh? I remain unimpressed.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: My netches move faster than these so called challengers.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: A sitting stone would offer more of a challenge.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: This fight drags like a limp leg.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: A nix-hound has more common sense than these challengers ….

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: Look at them, running around like headless bantam guars.

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: "These are our challengers? Hmm." [verification needed — when exactly he says those last six?]

dialogue.speaker: Tames-the-Beast
dialogue.line: You have won, challengers. I yield.

related_quests: The Black Gauntlet: Enter a deadly gauntlet held by the Blackguards of Blackrose Prison.
summary: Tames-the-Beast is an Argonian master beast-handler and an elite member of the Blackguards. He has dominion over a wide variety of creatures, most notably netches, trolls, haj mota and wamasu. All of the creatures he controls are much stronger than those found in the wild. He serves as the boss of Round 2: Hall of Beasts and one of the bosses of Round 4: Mess Hall of Misery.
